responsibility: Implements the pass that isolates CFG paths leading to statically provable erroneous behavior, such as null dereferences or invalid attribute-driven paths. It duplicates blocks for edge-specific undefined behavior, redirects offending edges to the duplicates, replaces the triggering statements with traps or simplified returns, trims unreachable successors, and returns CFG/SSA cleanup work so later passes can exploit the pruned erroneous paths.
